record_scope_reconstruction: First phase directly observes Indonesian travellers refused admission at Motaain–Batugade. Later legal phase explicitly enumerates Motain, Suai Salele, Sakato and Oesilo with weekly entry/exit hours. Three posts are positively located; Oesilo/Napan has an unnamed candidate control but insufficient independently named geographic identity. March 2022 daily-entry observation names Batugade/Bobonaro, not a demonstrated complete reopening at every post.

source_checks.finding: Immigration source directly identifies March 19 Motaain refusal and Batugade counterpart.

March 28 reporting dates daily eligible-Indonesian entry from March 21 and specifically mentions Batugade and Bobonaro.
Immigration official enumerates all four paired names. Used for geographic identity, not retroactive 2021 operating status.
